overall_probability_quality_summary.warning: accuracy leader is not the log-loss leader; prioritize calibrated probability quality over accuracy-only gains

grand_slam_tournament_expanding_benchmar.description: Grand Slam-only benchmark using chronological train-before-tournament folds, bookmaker no-vig probability included where applicable.

coverage_diagnostics.note: Coverage diagnostics compare evaluated benchmark rows against known paper targets where available; available rows expose source coverage, while evaluated rows expose benchmark coverage.

where_advanced_beats_market.note: Research-only segment hypotheses from historical walk-forward rows; require multi-year stability and forward CLV/paper tracking before use.

where_residual_overlay_beats_market.note: Research-only segment hypotheses from historical walk-forward rows; require multi-year stability and forward CLV/paper tracking before use.

feature_notes.elo: overall/surface/Slam Elo updated after each date
feature_notes.early_round: title/final within 7-14 days, recent matches, rest, surface switch, tournament load
feature_notes.travel_schedule: location/country/continent switches and haversine travel distance from prior known tournament location; location map is intentionally partial and should be expanded
feature_notes.entry_context: qualifier/wildcard/lucky-loser/protected-ranking columns are wired as zero-valued placeholders until draw/entry ETL is added
feature_notes.challenger_form: Challenger momentum columns are wired as neutral placeholders until Challenger results are ingested
feature_notes.injury_absence: prior retirement/walkover and long-layoff proxy flags from match comments/rest days
feature_notes.style_matchup: rolling score-derived set/game/tiebreak/straight-set proxies; replace/augment with serve-return stats when available
feature_notes.tournament_context: rolling tournament/surface/round upset and favorite-win rates from prior matches only
feature_notes.slam: best-of-five flags, Slam records, Slam Elo
feature_notes.surface: surface Elo and rolling surface win rate
feature_notes.top_player: top10/top20 flags and records vs top10/top20
feature_notes.market_aware: market-aware model includes no-vig probability and logit as inputs; research-only baseline for residual/overlay thinking
feature_notes.market_bin_recalibrated: conservative no-lookahead reliability-bin offsets learned on prior-year training rows; bins without enough training rows keep the original market probability
feature_notes.paper_benchmark: Grand Slam-only train-before-tournament expanding-window benchmark compares market, logistic, spline-logistic, random forest, XGBoost, linear SVM, advanced voting, and residual overlay with accuracy/log-loss/Brier
feature_notes.statistically_enhanced_abilities: pre-match ability covariates are estimated only from prior matches: surface ability, score-derived serve/return proxy, best-of-five/Slam ability, recent form ability, and fatigue-adjusted ability
feature_notes.residual_overlay: fits result - no-vig-market as target, applies segment-tuned shrinkage, and uses specialist residual models in early ATP250, post-title/final, surface-switch, Grand Slam, top10, and early-surface-switch buckets
feature_notes.underperformance_filter: predicts rows where advanced features are likely worse than market; filtered overlay falls back to market when risk is high
feature_notes.clv: live/pre-match odds snapshots and CLV storage are handled by scripts/odds_snapshot_store.py; not used in historical backtest until real snapshots exist

disclaimer: Research only. No betting execution. Market-aware models use closing odds and must be adapted carefully for pre-match live odds/CLV tracking.
